messages:
maria: Quick note 02:12 UTC - ap-southeast1 reported rising GPU attach failures and multiple local nvme I/O errors. Seeing remounts and transient badblocks. suspected background cleaner overlap with large training batches.
opsbot: ALERT: nvme_io_errors > 15 on host gn-apse1-23 - metric spike at 02:11:54. Recent change: cleaner-schedule v2026.04.
anar: On it. pulling iostat + dmesg. early signal is repeated "nvme nsid 1 status: 0x2" then remounts. temp sensor trace shows short ~12s jumps to 74C before the first timeout. SMART: Reallocated_Sector_Ct increment on 2 devices.
lee: paste dmesg snippet?
maria: dmesg (snippet):
```
[02:11:50] nvme0: I/O 0x7fa1bd5 timed out, qid=3
[02:11:51] nvme0: status: 0x2 media error
[02:11:52] EXT4-fs (nvme0n1): mounted filesystem with errors, running e2fsck
[02:11:53] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 98765432
```
kyle: thermal spikes + reallocated sectors -> likely media recovering under thermal stress. We should avoid simultaneous janitor scrubs + batch allocations. Immediate suggestions: 1) pause cleaner schedules for ap-southeast1, 2) reduce cleaner parallelism to 1 on the fleet, 3) temporarily shift batch job placement away from nodes with SMART warnings.
anar: How do we pause? we can toggle via Helm value or flip feature flag. I can set cleaner.enabled=false for region via helm upgrade --reuse-values --set region=ap-southeast1,cleaner.enabled=false -n infra. That will roll quickly.
maria: also would like to add a 45s random jitter to scrub cron to avoid aligned bursts. small freq reduction (10-20%) while we stabilize.
lee: I'll run a canary: disable cleaner on 8 nodes with label region=ap-southeast1 and also mark them unschedulable for batch GPU jobs for 20m. If errors drop, we can scale region-wide.
opsbot: ACTION: helm upgrade triggered for cleaner toggle (canary nodes=8) at 02:20 UTC.
kyle: Plan B: start kernel nvme-fix backport on a small host cohort if disabling cleaner doesn't help. Backport reduces escalation from media error -> controller reset. Need SRE approval for reboot window.
maria: agree. Triage plan: 1) canary disable cleaner on 8 nodes (in progress), 2) monitor attach success rate and SMART deltas for 15m, 3) if <50% improvement -> open reboot/backport runbook and schedule 10-host canary for nvme-backport.
anar: Executed canary disable and cordon for those 8 nodes. patch command: `helm -n infra upgrade cleaner infra/cleaner --set region=ap-southeast1,cleaner.enabled=false --reuse-values --timeout 5m`
lee: Monitoring: attach failures dropped from 12/min -> 4/min in the first 8m on canary set, SMART increments paused. Good sign. continuing observation.
maria: sweet. kyle, prep backport ticket but hold until 30m if trend continues. I'll update incidents channel and suppress noisy alerts for nvme_io_errors but keep a trimmed alert to watch the delta. :eyes: :thumbsup:
